items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I hadn’t heard that. I’d heard the records with Bird and Diz made, but I hadn’t heard Miles yet.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was looking for Bird.
Had you heard the records that he had recorded with Bird, “Ko-Ko,” “Billie’s Bounce”?
No, actually “Billy’s Bounce,” no, I hadn’t heard that. I’d heard the records with Bird and Diz made, but I hadn’t heard Miles yet.
